title: Glistering melon slice update
description: mod that updates the glistering melon slice and adds mobs and weapon.
body:
a mod that adds more thing to glistering melon!
NEW MOBS:
melon jerk - little melon guy that rolling around and hurt you. drop glistering shards.
the chubby - mini boss. he is big and slow but do a lot of damage.
NEW BLOCK:
the chubby spawner - can be found in the new structure (more about it down there). trigger with the new glistering shards and summon the chubby and 4 melon jerks.
NEW WEAPON:
glistering melon knife - fast knife that you can throw by right clicking.

THATS IT...!
